title: The Rich Desire Pyramid (5 Reasons Wealthy Clients Buy)
rules: Status (Make me look important): Position as the undisputed best, never the cheapest. When asked for discounts, charge more for superior expertise ('pay a pro now or regret an amateur later').
Convenience (Make my life easier): Wealthy buyers trade unlimited money to buy back time. Eliminate friction via white-glove onboarding, concierge tiers, and done-for-you ecosystems.
Exclusivity (Let me in, keep others out): Enforce hard gates, strict vetting criteria, income validation, and VIP membership barriers that keep standard clients away.
Privacy (Give me some space): Offer high-security, high-trust protocols (e.g., NDAs for service workers, metadata scrubbing, communication guards) to provide discretion.
Scarcity (Make it hard to get): Invert common small business instincts by intentionally restricting inventory or capacity using waitlists, application processes, and one-of-one assets.
